caption: The drawing depicts three adjacent sections of geometric quilt patterns rendered in colored pencil or crayon. The main section on the left consists of a grid of repeating square motifs, each with a white diamond shape at the center, surrounded by tan, red, and blue triangles arranged in intricate lattice and star-like formations. The colors in this section are primarily tan, red, white, blue, and a few small areas of black. The section above and to the right of the central grid features larger squares and triangles in similar patterns, but with more prominent use of white space and individual large areas filled with red, blue, black, and tan. The rightmost section contains overlapping geometric shapes, filled with lighter shades of yellow, blue, red, black, and tan, and appears to emphasize diagonal lines more than the grid below it. Fine black lines outline the individual pieces and segments of color throughout the drawing. The entire composition is framed by simple straight lines, and the scale is noted in the bottom left and right. A handwritten signature and text appear along the bottom edge.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
